### Diff-aware

Used automatically when /qa runs on a feature branch and no URL was given.

| Diff contains | Browser plan |
|---|---|
| Routes, controllers, views, components | Open each affected page; exercise the changed interaction end to end |
| CSS / style files | Open every page that includes the stylesheet, at desktop and 375px widths |
| Models, services, API handlers | Open the pages whose flows call them; submit the forms that hit the changed endpoint |
| Config, env defaults, feature flags | Open the pages behind the flag or setting; confirm they load and behave |
| Prompt templates, copy files, i18n strings | Open the pages that display the generated or translated text; read it on screen |
| Nothing that maps to a page | Quick mode: homepage + top 5 navigation targets, console checked on each |

Every row ends in the browser. There is no row for "skip browser testing".

Detect the app: use the supplied URL, else the first of `localhost:3000`, `:4000`, `:8080` that responds, else a staging/preview URL from the PR; ask the user only if none work.
